== Biography ==
Nancy was born in 1843. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-835|Robert Glasgow]] and [[McFall-388|Phebe McFall]].  She passed away in 1849.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-835]] is assessed at 78% (probable). The held family account identifies Nancy Emeline Glasgow as Robert Barclay Glasgow’s child, generally with Phebe McFall. Nancy Emeline’s 1843–1849 memorial fits, but its parent wording is not retained.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect the child’s earliest household and the cited Faris page or original gravestone parent inscription.

=== Father relationship: Faris family review — 24 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-835|Robert Barclay Glasgow]] is now assessed at 95% (confident), up from 78% on 22 October 2026. This review supersedes the earlier father grade above.

Nancy Emeline’s full name and exact dates, 2 June 1843 and 5 March 1849, match the printed child list and existing short-lived Tranquility account. This specific family and lifetime identify her as the listed Robert/Phoebe child. The actual Faris pp. 46–47 were visually checked. They explicitly group these children under Robert Barclay Glasgow and Phoebe McFall; Robert’s own dates, two wives and Ohio–Iowa life identify the father account. These exact percentages are subjective assessments of each complete father/profile pair, not statistical measurements.<ref name="FarisRobertChildren1990">David Faris, ''The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio'' (Baltimore: Gateway Press,1990), [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CS3J-H9F6-3 printed pp. 46–47], DGS 007834162,image 1583; actual printed pages visually checked 24 October 2026. Retrospective genealogy; original family and census records not inspected. The Bible provenance on p. 32 concerns the previous generation and is not asserted for this child list.</ref>

The profile retains Ohio as birthplace, whereas the book’s narrative reports Indiana for Nancy and Susanna. That reported place discrepancy remains open; no birthplace field changes. Original birth and burial records remain uninspected. This is one retrospective compiled family history. Its list, reported censuses, modern family fields and memorial citations may share evidence; repeated details are not independent proofs. No original birth register, census, Bible or burial record was newly inspected. The 1927 Bible provenance on p. 32 concerns William and Rhoda’s children, not the dates of Robert’s next generation; it is not transferred here. Existing named fathers remain selected. Mothers are separate, ungraded or unselected where previously so. No new parent attachment, merge or live save.
